safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports feeling hot/cold and sweaty, but has had no fevers.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No mention in Generated of hot/cold/sweats or denial of fevers.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting hot/cold sweats and the explicit denial of fever can distort infectious risk assessment and the clinician’s threshold for further evaluation (e.g., influenza vs. bacterial infection), but is unlikely by itself to cause major harm in an otherwise uncomplicated viral-illness presentation.
